note: Collingsworth County publishes no zoning districts layer; Texas counties generally do not zone. The county's cities: Shamrock publishes its zoning district map only as a PDF (ShamrockTX-MAP-2024-rev3.pdf), no queryable service. Wellington has no GIS zoning found; its only GIS parcel data (Dynamo Spatial) is paywalled and lists zoning fields only in a commercial shapefile. ArcGIS searches for Collingsworth returned only precincts, polling sites, parcels and a CAD parcel map with no zoning.
